title: 天皇賞（秋）の後に・泥道こそ花道

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: So what if it's raining? So what if it's muddy? I'll take 'em head-on and leave 'em all in my wake!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: RAAAH! ONWAAAAARD!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Unbelievable! Kitasan Black is cutting through the mud and muck with incredible power! She's sprinting for the finish line and—

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Wow! She's standing triumphantly in the middle of the track! What a sight! The crowd of 60,000 strong is in utter disbelief!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: What… what was that? She didn't even stumble while going through the worst bits on the track!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: That's Kitasan Black for you! Even when others shy away, she charges right in!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: Wooooo! That was awesome! Go, Kitasaaan! You're the best!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text: Dang, how are you this good?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As she soaks in the crowd's cheers, Kitasan Black's expression is more akin to one of satisfaction at a job well done rather than one of joy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clutch captain Kitasan Black was completely unphased by the torrential storm and has managed to win smiles from the whole crowd.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Kita… You're just too amazing… I only ever think about winning my races, but you…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: You're different. You care about things far beyond your own victory…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I can't compare with you at all, let alone win against you. I…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I have to become better as well before the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: This all worked out thanks to you! I really won after following your plan to the letter!
choice_data_list: Nope, it's your strength that made this win possible!
Nope, it's your strength that made this win possible!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That strategy would've gone nowhere if she didn't have tremendous fortitude and power to overcome such poor conditions. It only worked because we believed in each other's strengths.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: That was a race for the ages, Kitasan Black! You put on a real show, thundering through the mud.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Thanks! The weather wasn't the greatest, but I did my best to give everyone a good time!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: The fans had it rough out there today, but I promise…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Next time, I'll treat everyone to a huge and cheery festival like they've never seen before!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: A huge festival? Could it be? Are you alluding to what I think you're talking about?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I am! I'm talking about a worldwide festival where the best of the best Umamusume gather!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I'm going to be running with the biggest names in the Japan Cup! We'll get the party started at Tokyo Racecourse one more time!
